intro: London International College and Starex University both sit in Gurgaon, and this page compares their recorded BSc fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

London International College vs Starex University is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: London International College vs Starex University for BSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose London International College if its BSc programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose Starex University if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.

London International College lists Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Business & Management, Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Computer Technology. Starex University lists B. Sc. in Radiological Imaging Techniques (Radiology/CT/MRI), B.Sc (Non-Medical), Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Computer Science and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹11.31 lakh a year as tuition fees for London International College's Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Computer Technology. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹75,000 a year as total fees for Starex University's Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Forensic Science. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, London International College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh for Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Computer Technology. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, Starex University's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh for Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Computer Science. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

paragraphs: Both campuses are in Gurgaon, Delhi NCR. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: There is no universal winner in London International College vs Starex University for BSc. Use the programme list, the official fee notice and the admission test to decide.
If one side is missing a quotable fee or a recent official placement year, do not fill the gap with a guess from another course or an older batch.
